source.notes: Codex reads the portable Agent Plugins 1.0 layout (root plugin.json, mcp.json, skills/) with its own data under extensions["com.openai"]. plugin.schema.json and mcp.schema.json are the Agent Plugins 1.0.0 schemas, copied unchanged with only x-source added.
